entries.title: The Deeprun Tram
body: A long, fully enclosed underground railway of twin tracks between Stormwind and Ironforge, part of it running through glass tunnels beneath a great subterranean lake. It is fast, smooth and free to all travellers, and gnome engineers work on it every day to keep it so.

It was built after the Second War. Magni Bronzebeard was frustrated at how slowly Ironforge's aid reached Stormwind, and wanted a way to send dwarven soldiers quickly if the humans ever needed them, so he turned to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, who drew up a grand subterranean railway, and made a scale model of it out of pie tins.

entries.title: Rats in the Tunnels
body: The tram had its troubles: the subterranean lake, and an invasion of rats. The lake was mastered; the rats never were. Monty, the rat extermination specialist, still hunts them in the tunnels.
